properties.name: A finding is written before the answer and needs nobody's permission — intent waits for the owner's word, an observation does not
properties.statement: A contradiction you noticed, a number that does not add up, a measurement you took, a cause you established: these are the agent's own observations. Write each with record_finding the moment you have it, before the next answer, and never offer to fold it into a document. Only INTENT waits for the owner's word — a requirement, a decision, a status. Measured 2026-09-18 on flo2: six design findings from a document review stayed in chat because the agent had generalised 'intent waits' into 'everything waits'; the same day the maintainer's own triage repeated the class. A session that reads for an hour and writes nothing looks clean to every signal that counts nodes; loop_status now counts this session's reads and writes and says so.
